extra: Trap: 16(4) 'adequate representation', Art 15(4) 'social and educational backwardness' - dono alag test hain, exam me confuse karaya jata hai.

detail: Chhuachhoot khatam aur uska kisi bhi roop me palan dandaniya. Ye ek aisa FR hai jo private vyaktiyon ke khilaf bhi chalta hai (sirf State ke khilaf nahi). Isi ko lagu karne ke liye Protection of Civil Rights Act 1955 aur SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act 1989 bane.
extra: Trap: Art 17 me 'untouchability' word define nahi kiya gaya - isse traditional caste-based practice maana jata hai, kisi general social boycott ko cover nahi karta.

detail: State military ya academic ke alawa koi title nahi dega, aur citizen kisi videshi rajya se title nahi lega. Balaji Raghavan case (1996) me SC ne kaha Bharat Ratna/Padma awards 'title' nahi hain, isliye valid hain - par unhe naam ke aage-peeche nahi lagaya ja sakta.
extra: Trap: Military ranks (General, Field Marshal) aur academic degrees (Dr., PhD) 'title' ke exception hain isliye Art 18 unhe touch nahi karta.

detail: 6 azadiyan: (a) speech & expression, (b) assembly, (c) association, (d) movement, (e) residence, (g) profession. (Right to property 19(1)(f) 44th Amendment se hata). Har freedom par 'reasonable restrictions' lag sakti hain. Shreya Singhal (2015) me IT Act ki Section 66A 19(1)(a) ke khilaf hone se rad hui; Anuradha Bhasin (2020) ne internet shutdown par proportionality test lagaya.
extra: Trap: Art 19 sirf citizens ko milta hai (companies/foreigners ko nahi, sirf corporation ke shareholders individually claim kar sakte hain - Bennett Coleman case).

answer: Protection in respect of conviction for offences
detail: Teen suraksha: (1) ex-post-facto law nahi (jo kaam tab crime nahi tha uske liye baad me saza nahi), (2) double jeopardy (ek apradh ke liye do baar saza nahi), (3) self-incrimination ke khilaf (apne khilaf gawahi dene ki majboori nahi). Emergency me bhi Art 20 suspend nahi ho sakta (44th Amendment).
extra: Trap: Art 20 emergency me bhi suspend nahi hota (44th Amendment se confirm) - ye Art 21 ke saath 'non-suspendable' FR hai.

answer: Protection of life and personal liberty
detail: Sabse zyada expand hone wala article. A.K. Gopalan (1950) me sankuchit reading thi, par Maneka Gandhi (1978) ne kaha procedure 'fair, just and reasonable' honi chahiye - isse Art 14-19-21 ki 'golden triangle' bani. Ab isme shamil hai: privacy (Puttaswamy 2017), swachh paryavaran, izzat se jeena, jaldi trial, shelter, health, sona, aur Common Cause (2018) me passive euthanasia. Emergency me bhi suspend nahi ho sakta.
extra: Trap: Art 21 'procedure established by law' hai, USA ka 'due process of law' nahi - par Maneka Gandhi ke baad practically dono qareeb aa gaye hain.

detail: 86th Amendment 2002 se joda - 6 se 14 saal ke har bachche ko free aur compulsory shiksha. Ise lagu karne ke liye RTE Act 2009 bana jisme private schools me 25% weaker section seats ka provision hai (Society for Unaided Schools case 2012 me upheld). Isi Amendment ne Art 45 ko badalkar 0-6 saal ki early childhood care par focus kiya aur duty 51A(k) jodi.
extra: Trap: Art 21A sirf 6-14 age-group cover karta hai; 0-6 age DPSP Art 45 (non-justiciable) me hai - dono ko mix karna common trap hai.

detail: Do hisse: (1) normal arrest me - girftari ka kaaran batana, vakil ka haq, 24 ghante me magistrate ke saamne pesh karna. (2) Preventive detention me ye suraksha nahi milti - 3 mahine tak bina Advisory Board ke rakha ja sakta hai. Ye duniya ka virle constitutions me se hai jisme preventive detention shanti ke samay bhi constitutionally allowed hai (NSA, COFEPOSA).
extra: Trap: Preventive detention me FR ki normal suraksha (vakil, 24-ghante peshi) nahi milti - ye 'punishment for crime already committed' nahi balki 'anticipatory' measure hai.

answer: Prohibition of traffic in human beings and forced labour
detail: Manav taskari, begar aur bandhua mazdoori par rok - ye State aur private dono ke khilaf chalta hai. PUDR v. Union of India (1982, Asiad Workers case) me SC ne kaha minimum wage se kam dena bhi 'forced labour' hai. Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act 1976 iska implementation hai.
extra: Trap: Art 23(2) ka compulsory service exception (jaise military/social service scheme) discriminatory nahi hona chahiye - ye Art 23 ka 'permitted' hissa hai.

answer: Prohibition of employment of children in factories
detail: 14 saal se chhote bachche ko factory, khan ya kisi khatarnaak kaam me nahi lagaya ja sakta. M.C. Mehta v. State of Tamil Nadu (Sivakasi patakha case) me SC ne rehabilitation fund aur employer par muavze ka aadesh diya. Child Labour (Prohibition & Regulation) Act 1986 aur 2016 amendment isi se jude hain.
extra: Trap: Art 24 sirf 'hazardous' employment cover karta hai; non-hazardous family business me kaam karna statutory law (2016 Amendment) se conditionally allowed hai, Art 24 khud isse exempt nahi karta directly.

answer: Freedom of conscience and free profession, practice and propagation of religion
detail: Har vyakti ko antaratma ki azadi aur dharm maanne, palan karne aur prachar karne ka haq - par public order, morality, health aur Part III ke doosre provisions ke adheen. 'Propagate' ka matlab prachar hai, jabardasti dharmantaran nahi (Stainislaus case 1977). 'Essential Religious Practices' test se court tay karta hai kaunsi pratha protected hai (Sabarimala, Shayara Bano).
extra: Trap: Art 25 individual right hai (Art 26 institutional/denominational right hai) - dono ko exam me swap karana common mistake hai.

detail: Kisi bhi nagrik-samuh ko apni alag bhasha, lipi ya sanskriti bachane ka haq, aur State-funded institution me dharm/jaati/bhasha ke aadhar par admission se inkaar nahi. Dhyan do - Art 29 ka faayda sirf minorities ko nahi, kisi bhi 'section of citizens' ko milta hai.
extra: Trap: Art 29 minorities-specific nahi hai (common misconception) - Art 30 minorities-specific hai, ye distinction PYQ me baar-baar aata hai.

answer: Right of minorities to establish and administer educational institutions
detail: Dharmik aur bhashai alpsankhyakon ko apne shikshan sansthan banane aur chalane ka haq; State grant dete waqt bhedbhav nahi karega. T.M.A. Pai Foundation (2002) ne kaha 'minority' ka nirdharan state-level par hoga aur State reasonable regulation (merit, standards) laga sakta hai.
extra: Trap: RTE Act ka 25% EWS quota Art 30 minority unaided institutions par lagu nahi hota (Pramati Trust case, 2014) - ye Art 21A/RTE ka bada exception hai.

detail: Ambedkar ke shabdon me 'heart and soul of the Constitution'. Seedhe Supreme Court jaane ka haq jab FR ka ullanghan ho - aur ye khud ek Fundamental Right hai. 5 writs: Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Certiorari, Quo Warranto. Art 226 (High Court) ka daayra isse chauda hai kyunki wo legal rights ke liye bhi chalta hai. Emergency me bhi ab Art 20-21 ke liye ise nahi roka ja sakta (44th Amendment, ADM Jabalpur ka sudhar).
extra: Trap: Art 32 khud ek Fundamental Right hai (Part III me), jabki Art 226 sirf High Court ka jurisdiction hai FR nahi - isliye Art 32 sirf FR ke liye hi hota hai, ordinary legal rights ke liye nahi.

detail: Non-justiciable nirdesh jo 'welfare state' banane ke liye hain. Art 38 (samajik-arthik nyay), 39 (samaan vetan, sampatti ka kendrikaran na ho), 39A (free legal aid, 42nd Amdt), 40 (Gram Panchayat), 41 (kaam-shiksha-sahayta ka haq), 43B (co-operatives, 97th Amdt), 44 (Uniform Civil Code), 45 (0-6 saal early childhood care), 48A (paryavaran, 42nd Amdt), 50 (nyaypalika ko karyapalika se alag karna), 51 (antarrashtriya shanti).
extra: Trap: DPSP non-justiciable hain (Art 37) par 'fundamental in governance' - courts inko FR ke saath harmoniously construe karke enforceable bana dete hain.

answer: Certain principles of policy to be followed by the State
detail: Socialist DPSP ka core: jeevan-yapan ke saadhan sabko, samaj ke bhautik sansadhanon ka common good ke liye baantwara, dhan ka kendrikaran na ho, purush-mahila ko samaan kaam par samaan vetan, aur bachchon ka swastha vikas. Art 39(b)-(c) ko Art 31C ke through FR se upar rakha gaya tha - Kesavananda aur Minerva Mills ne is par limit lagayi.
extra: Trap: Art 39(b)-(c) hi wo do clauses hain jinhe Art 31C special constitutional protection deta hai, baaki DPSP ko nahi.

answer: Equal justice and free legal aid
detail: 42nd Amendment 1976 se joda. Isi se Legal Services Authorities Act 1987, NALSA aur Lok Adalat ka poora system bana - taki paise ki kami ki wajah se kisi ko nyay na milna na ruke.
extra: Trap: Free legal aid original DPSP hi hai (Art 39A) par SC ne Hussainara Khatoon se ise Art 21 ka enforceable hissa bhi bana diya - dono answer options exam me possible hote hain.

detail: Gandhian DPSP - gram swaraj ka sapna. 43 saal tak ye sirf kagaz par tha; 73rd Amendment 1992 ne ise Part IX banakar constitutional reality bana diya.
extra: Trap: Art 40 khud DPSP hai (non-justiciable), par 73rd Amendment ne Panchayat provisions ko Part IX me daalkar justiciable/binding structural mandate bana diya.

answer: Right to work, to education and to public assistance
detail: Berozgari, budhapa, bimari aur viklangta me sarkari sahayta ka nirdesh. MGNREGA, old-age pension schemes aur social security codes isi DPSP ka practical roop hain.
extra: Trap: 'Right to work' Art 41 me DPSP hai, Fundamental Right nahi - isliye ise court me directly enforce nahi kiya ja sakta, sirf statutory scheme (MGNREGA) ke through hi milta hai.

detail: 97th Amendment 2011 se joda - co-operatives ka swaichhik gathan, swayattata, loktantrik niyantran aur professional management. Isi Amendment ne Art 19(1)(c) me 'co-operative societies' bhi joda.
extra: Trap: Co-operative societies State List ka subject hai isliye 97th Amendment ka Part IXB Art 368(2) proviso ke tahat states ki ratification maangta tha - na hone se SC ne partly strike kiya.

detail: State poore India me nagrikon ke liye ek samaan civil code laane ki koshish karega. Shah Bano (1985) aur Sarla Mudgal (1995) me SC ne UCC ki yaad dilayi. Goa me Portuguese-era civil code pehle se hai; Uttarakhand ne 2024 me UCC pass kiya.
extra: Trap: UCC abhi Fundamental Right nahi, sirf DPSP hai - courts baar-baar 'reminder' dete hain lekin implementation ka faisla legislature (Parliament/State) ka hai.

answer: Early childhood care and education below 6 years
detail: Original Art 45 kehta tha 10 saal me 14 tak sabko free education. 86th Amendment 2002 ne wo hissa Art 21A (FR) me shift kiya aur Art 45 ko 0-6 saal ke bachchon ki care ke liye reword kar diya - ICDS/Anganwadi isi se jude hain.
extra: Trap: Original Art 45 aur current Art 45 ka content bilkul alag hai - 2002 se pehle wale 6-14 age wale content ab Art 21A me hai, ye common confusion point hai.

answer: Protection of environment, forests and wildlife
detail: 42nd Amendment 1976 se joda. SC ne is DPSP ko Art 21 ke saath padhkar 'right to clean environment' banaya (Subhash Kumar case) aur Public Trust Doctrine, Polluter Pays, Precautionary Principle apnaye.
extra: Trap: 42nd Amendment ne Art 48A (DPSP) aur Art 51A(g) (duty) dono saath joड़े - environment protection ka double textual base hai, sirf ek article nahi.

detail: Nyaypalika ko karyapalika se alag karne ka nirdesh - isi ke chalte CrPC 1973 ne Judicial Magistrate aur Executive Magistrate ke role alag kiye.
extra: Trap: Art 50 sirf subordinate/district-level judiciary-executive separation ke liye hai, higher judiciary (HC/SC) ki independence alag provisions (Art 50 se independent - jaise Art 121, 124, 211) se aati hai.

answer: Promotion of international peace and security
detail: Antarrashtriya shanti, sammanjanak sambandh, international law ka aadar aur arbitration se vivaad suljhana. Isi ke aadhar par SC ne international conventions (jaise CEDAW in Vishaka case) ko domestic law me padha.
extra: Trap: Art 51 ki wajah se international treaties automatically domestic law nahi ban jaate (dualist system) - Parliament ko alag se enabling legislation banana padta hai, sirf interpretation me help milti hai.

detail: 11 mool kartavya - 42nd Amendment 1976 (Swaran Singh Committee, USSR se prerit) me 10, aur 86th Amendment 2002 me 11th. Legally enforceable nahi, par court inhe interpretation me use karta hai aur inke aadhar par banaye gaye laws ko validity milti hai.
extra: Trap: Fundamental Duties mein koi legal sanction/penalty nahi hai - inka ullanghan seedhe punishable nahi hai, sirf 'moral obligation' hai, isse confuse karke FR jaisa treat karna galat hoga.

detail: 'Bharat ka ek Rashtrapati hoga.' Ye desh ka constitutional head aur first citizen hai - poori Union executive power (Art 53) uske naam par chalti hai, par actual istemal Council of Ministers ki salah par hota hai.
extra: Trap: 'There shall be a President' - is single-line drafting se hi exam me pucha jaata hai ki koi numbered sub-clause nahi hai isme, seedha declaratory statement hai.

detail: Electoral College: dono Houses ke elected MPs + saare States ki Vidhan Sabhaon ke elected MLAs + Delhi aur Puducherry ke MLAs. Nominated members aur MLCs vote nahi dete. Ye Art 368 ke third category me aata hai - iska amendment states ke ratification ke bina nahi ho sakta.
extra: Trap: Art 54 amendment Art 368(2) proviso ke 'entrenched' category me aata hai - iske liye special majority + kam se kam aadhi states ki ratification zaroori hai, kyunki ye states ke election-role ko affect karta hai.

answer: Manner of election of the President
detail: Proportional representation, single transferable vote, secret ballot. MLA ke vote ki value = state ki aabadi (1971 census) / (elected MLAs x 1000); MP ke vote ki value = saare MLAs ki total value / elected MPs ki sankhya. Jeetne ke liye 'quota' (total valid votes ka 50% + 1) chahiye - isliye ise majority nahi, 'quota system' kehte hain.
extra: Trap: President election 'majority' se nahi 'quota system' se jeeta jaata hai - ye ek common exam distinction hai (majority ≠ quota).

answer: Term of office of the President
detail: 5 saal ka karyakaal, jo Vice-President ko likhkar resign karne, ya impeachment se pehle bhi khatam ho sakta hai. Naya President na aane tak purana pad par bana rehta hai.
extra: Trap: President resign VP ko karta hai (not Speaker/PM) - ye chhota par frequently pucha jaane wala fact hai.

detail: President kitni bhi baar dobara chun sakta hai - koi term limit nahi (USA se ulta). Bharat me sirf Dr. Rajendra Prasad do baar bane.
extra: Trap: USA ki tarah India me President ke liye koi term-limit nahi (US me 22nd Amendment se max 2 terms) - ye comparative-constitution question me common trap hai.

detail: Indian citizen, 35 saal ki umar, Lok Sabha ka member banne ki yogyata, aur koi 'office of profit' na ho (President/VP/Governor/Minister office of profit nahi maane jate). Nomination ke liye 50 proposers aur 50 seconders zaroori hain.
extra: Trap: Office of profit ka exception khud Presidents/Ministers ko cover karta hai isliye sitting Governor/Minister/VP bhi President ka election lad sakte hain bina resign kiye pehle.

answer: Oath or affirmation by the President
detail: Shapath Chief Justice of India (unki gair-maujoodgi me sabse senior SC judge) dilata hai - 'Constitution aur law ka rakshan, sanrakshan aur pratirakshan' ka vachan. Yahi wo shapath hai jo President ko bill par assent ke faisle me constitutional maryada se baandhti hai.
extra: Trap: Oath CJI dilata hai, Speaker ya PM nahi - VP ka oath President dilata hai (Art 69) - dono ko swap karna common confusion hai.

answer: Procedure for impeachment of the President
detail: Sirf 'violation of the Constitution' ke aadhar par. Kisi bhi House me 1/4th members ke signature aur 14 din ka notice; phir us House me total membership ka 2/3rd majority; doosra House investigate karta hai aur wahan bhi 2/3rd chahiye. Nominated members bhi is process me bhaag lete hain (election ke ulta). Aaj tak kisi President par impeachment nahi hua.
extra: Trap: Impeachment ke liye 'total membership' ka 2/3rd chahiye, sirf 'present and voting' ka nahi - ye Governor removal (jo procedure hi nahi hai, sirf President ki pleasure) se bhi alag hai.

detail: 'Bharat ka ek Up-Rashtrapati hoga.' Wo Rajya Sabha ka ex-officio Chairman hai aur President ka pad khali hone par 6 mahine tak kaam sambhalta hai (Art 65).
extra: Trap: VP ka primary constitutional role Rajya Sabha Chairman hona hai, President banna sirf contingency provision (Art 65) hai - dono roles ko conflate karna galat hai.

detail: Electoral College me dono Houses ke saare members hote hain - elected + nominated dono (President ke election se yahi bada antar hai), par MLAs nahi. Yogyata: 35 saal, Rajya Sabha ka member banne layak.
extra: Trap: VP ke electoral college me MLAs nahi hote, sirf MPs (elected + nominated) - President ke electoral college se ye key distinction PYQ me repeatedly aata hai.

answer: Discharge of President's functions in other contingencies
detail: Jab Art 65 ke halaat cover na hon (jaise President aur VP dono ka pad khali ho), tab Parliament vyavastha kar sakti hai. Isi ke tahat 1969 me CJI M. Hidayatullah acting President bane the.
extra: Trap: Art 65 aur Art 70 alag scenarios cover karte hain - Art 65 sirf President-vacancy me VP ke liye hai, Art 70 'other contingencies' (dono pad khaali) ke liye Parliament ko law-making power deta hai.

detail: Paanch shaktiyan: Pardon (saza aur dosh dono maaf), Commutation (saza ka roop halka), Remission (avadhi kam), Respite (vishesh paristhiti me kam), Reprieve (fansi ka asthai sthagan). Court-martial aur death sentence ke maamle me sirf President ke paas hai (Governor ke paas nahi). Ye power Cabinet ki advice par chalti hai aur judicial review ke daayre me hai (Epuru Sudhakar case).
extra: Trap: Death sentence aur court-martial cases sirf President pardon kar sakta hai, Governor (Art 161) nahi - state law ke tahat death sentence me bhi ye difference lagu hota hai.

answer: Extent of executive power of the Union
detail: Union ki executive power wahan tak jaati hai jahan tak Parliament kanoon bana sakti hai (Union List), aur treaty/agreement se milne wale adhikar tak. Concurrent List par sadharantah rajya hi executive kaam karte hain.
extra: Trap: Sirf 'legislative competence' hone se 'executive power' automatically nahi milti - Concurrent List par proviso ki wajah se State ka executive control default rehता hai jab tak specific law na ho.

answer: Council of Ministers to aid and advise the President
detail: PM ke netritva me Council of Ministers President ko salah dega. 42nd Amendment ne salah ko 'binding' banaya, aur 44th Amendment ne joda ki President ek baar punarvichar (reconsideration) ke liye wapas bhej sakta hai, par doosri baar wahi salah aane par maanna hi padega. Art 74(2) kehta hai ye salah court me nahi poochi ja sakti.
extra: Trap: Art 74(2) ki wajah se advice ka content court me challenge nahi kiya ja sakta (immunity), par decision khud judicial review se bahar nahi hai - ye subtle distinction PYQ me trap banti hai.

answer: Appointment of the Prime Minister and Ministers
detail: 75(1): President PM ko niyukt karta hai aur baaki mantriyon ko PM ki salah par. 75(1A) (91st Amendment): Council of Ministers Lok Sabha ki strength ke 15% se zyada nahi. 75(3): Council of Ministers samuhik roop se Lok Sabha ke prati uttardayi hai - yahi parliamentary system ki jaan hai. Minister ko 6 mahine ke andar kisi House ka member banna zaroori (75(5)).
extra: Trap: 15% cap sirf Lok Sabha strength par based hai (543 ka 15% ≈ 81), aur ye Union aur State dono Councils of Ministers par 91st Amendment se lagu hota hai (Art 164(1A) State ke liye parallel provision).

detail: Desh ka sabse bada law officer, President dwara niyukt, yogyata SC judge jaisi. Sarkar ko legal salah deta hai, saare courts me sunwai ka haq rakhta hai, Parliament ki karyavahi me bhaag le sakta hai par vote nahi de sakta. Ye sarkari naukar nahi hai - private practice kar sakta hai (kuch pabandiyon ke saath).
extra: Trap: AG na to Council of Ministers ka member hai na Parliament ka - wo dono Houses ki proceedings me bol sakta hai bina member hue, par vote nahi de sakta, ye unique hybrid position hai.

detail: Parliament = President + Rajya Sabha + Lok Sabha. Britain ke model par President legislature ka ang hai (USA me nahi) - isi liye bill President ke assent ke bina kanoon nahi banta.
extra: Trap: India me President 'part of legislature' hai (UK model), jabki USA me President legislature ka hissa nahi. Ye difference exams me frequently pucha jata hai.

detail: Adhiktam 250: 238 states/UTs se aur 12 President dwara nominated (sahitya, vigyan, kala, samaj seva). Abhi actual 245. State ke pratinidhi Vidhan Sabha ke elected MLAs proportional representation aur single transferable vote se chunte hain. 2003 me domicile requirement hataya gaya aur open ballot lagu hua.
extra: Trap: RS members ka election domicile-based nahi rehta ab (2003 se) - koi bhi state se Rajya Sabha election lad sakta hai bina us state ka resident hue.

detail: Adhiktam 550: 530 states se + 20 UTs se. (Anglo-Indian nomination 104th Amendment 2019 se khatam.) Abhi 543. Seats aur constituencies ka baantwara 1971 census par freeze hai - 84th Amendment ne 2026 tak, jo ab 106th Amendment ke women's reservation ko bhi delimitation se joda gaya hai.
extra: Trap: Delimitation freeze 1971 census par based hai, current population par nahi - isliye seat allocation population-proportion se match nahi karta abhi.

detail: 83(1): Rajya Sabha bhang nahi hoti - permanent house, har 2 saal me 1/3rd members retire hote hain, term 6 saal. 83(2): Lok Sabha ka term 5 saal, par pehle bhang ho sakti hai; National Emergency me ek baar me 1 saal tak badhaya ja sakta hai (emergency khatam hone ke 6 mahine se zyada nahi).
extra: Trap: RS 'never dissolves' - continuing chamber hai; sirf LS dissolve hoti hai, isliye RS 'permanent house of Parliament' kehlati hai.

detail: Indian citizen, Rajya Sabha ke liye 30 saal aur Lok Sabha ke liye 25 saal ki umar, shapath lena, aur Parliament dwara nirdharit anya yogyatayein (RP Act 1951).
extra: Trap: Min age RS ke liye 30, LS ke liye 25 - different from voting age (18). Common confusion in prelims.

detail: Do sessions ke beech 6 mahine se zyada ka antar nahi ho sakta - yani saal me kam se kam do baar baithak. Aam taur par teen sessions: Budget, Monsoon, Winter. Prorogation session khatam karta hai (pending bill nahi marte), dissolution sirf Lok Sabha ki hoti hai (aur usse pending bills lapse ho jate hain).
extra: Trap: 6-month gap rule sirf sessions ke beech hai, saal me minimum sessions ki sankhya constitution me specify nahi hai.

answer: Voting in Houses and casting vote of the Speaker
detail: Faisle upasthit aur vote karne wale members ke bahumat se hote hain. Speaker/Chairman pehle vote nahi deta, par tie hone par 'casting vote' deta hai - ye neutrality ka principle hai. Quorum: House ki total membership ka 1/10th.
extra: Trap: Quorum is 1/10th of total membership, not of present members - frequently confused in MCQs.

detail: Deadlock (bill reject, 6 mahine ki deri, ya amendments par asehmati) me President dono Houses ki sanyukt baithak bulata hai jiski adhyakshta Lok Sabha ka Speaker karta hai. Money Bill aur Constitutional Amendment Bill par joint sitting nahi hoti. Aaj tak sirf 3 baar hui: Dowry Prohibition Bill 1961, Banking Service Commission Repeal Bill 1978, POTA 2002.
extra: Trap: Joint sitting Money Bills aur Constitutional Amendment Bills (Article 368) ke liye available nahi hai - sirf ordinary bills ke liye.

answer: Special procedure in respect of Money Bills
detail: Money Bill sirf Lok Sabha me, President ki sifarish se aata hai. Rajya Sabha na to use reject kar sakti hai na amend - sirf 14 din me sifarish bhej sakti hai jo Lok Sabha maan bhi sakti hai aur nahi bhi. Isliye Money Bill par Lok Sabha poori tarah supreme hai.
extra: Trap: Money Bill sirf LS se introduce, RS 14 din me sirf recommend kar sakti hai - reject ya amend nahi kar sakti.

detail: Wo bill jisme sirf tax lagana/hataana, sarkar ka udhaar, Consolidated/Contingency Fund se paisa nikalna ya jama karna, appropriation, ya CAG ka audit shamil ho. Speaker ka certificate final hota hai. Aadhaar Act aur Finance Act ko Money Bill batane par vivaad hua (Rojer Mathew case) - maamla abhi bade bench ke paas hai.
extra: Trap: Speaker ka certificate 'final' hai as per Article 110(3), lekin SC ne recent judgments me judicial review ki possibility open rakhi hai - complete finality nahi.

detail: Har vitteeya varsh ke liye sarkar ko anumaanit aay-vyay ka byora Parliament ke saamne rakhna hi hoga. Kharche do tarah ke: 'Charged' (President/judges ki salary, karz ka byaaj - vote nahi hota) aur 'Made' (vote hota hai). Budget ke stages: presentation, general discussion, department-wise scrutiny, voting on demands, Appropriation Bill, Finance Bill.
extra: Trap: Charged expenditure Parliament me discuss ho sakta hai but vote nahi hota - only 'voted' expenditure par voting hoti hai.

answer: Special provisions as to Financial Bills
detail: Financial Bill Category I (Art 117(1)) Money Bill jaise hi Lok Sabha me President ki sifarish se aate hain par unme non-money matters bhi hote hain, isliye Rajya Sabha unhe amend/reject kar sakti hai. Category II (117(3)) me sirf Consolidated Fund se kharcha hota hai - koi bhi House shuru kar sakta hai.
extra: Trap: Financial Bill Category I sirf LS me introduce hota hai (Money Bill jaisa) but RS ise amend kar sakti hai - Money Bill me ye power RS ko nahi hoti.

answer: Courts not to inquire into proceedings of Parliament
detail: Parliament ki karyavahi ki validity par sirf 'procedural irregularity' ke aadhar par court sawaal nahi kar sakta - ye separation of powers ka hissa hai. Par 'substantive illegality' ya constitutional violation par court dakhal de sakta hai (Raja Ram Pal case 2007).
extra: Trap: Article 122 sirf 'irregularity of procedure' se immunity deta hai, 'illegality' se nahi - courts substantive violations ko review kar sakte hain.

detail: Jab Parliament ka session nahi chal raha ho aur turant kaarwai zaroori ho, President ordinance jaari kar sakta hai jiska asar kanoon jaisa hota hai. Session shuru hone ke 6 hafte ke andar Parliament ki manzoori zaroori, warna wo khatam. D.C. Wadhwa case (1987) me Bihar ke 'ordinance re-promulgation' ko SC ne 'fraud on the Constitution' kaha; Krishna Kumar Singh (2017) ne ise phir dohraaya.
extra: Trap: Ordinance ki life max 6 months + 6 weeks (agar dono sessions ke beech gap 6 mahine ho aur reassembly ke 6 weeks baad tak na pass ho).

answer: Establishment and constitution of the Supreme Court
detail: SC me CJI aur Parliament dwara tay judges (abhi CJI + 33 = 34). Niyukti President karta hai; Second Judges Case (1993) aur Third Judges Case (1998) ke baad 'Collegium system' chalta hai. Judge ko sirf 'proved misbehaviour or incapacity' par Art 124(4) ki special majority se hataya ja sakta hai - aaj tak koi SC judge nahi hataya gaya (Justice V. Ramaswami 1993 me motion fail hua).
extra: Trap: NJAC (99th Amendment, 2014) ko SC ne 2015 me unconstitutional declare kiya - collegium system hi wapas lagu hai judge appointments ke liye.

answer: Supreme Court to be a court of record
detail: SC ke faisle record hote hain, precedent maane jate hain, aur wo apni avmanna (contempt) par saza de sakti hai. Yahi power High Court ko Art 215 deta hai.
extra: Trap: SC ki contempt power constitutional hai (Article 129), statutory Contempt of Courts Act 1971 se limit/curtail nahi ki ja sakti.

answer: Original jurisdiction of the Supreme Court
detail: Centre-State ya State-State ke vivaad seedhe SC me. Punjab-Haryana SYL canal, Kerala vs Union (CAA) jaise maamle isi ke tahat aaye. Yahan sirf legal right ka sawaal hona chahiye, political dispute nahi.
extra: Trap: Article 131 me private individual/citizen party nahi ban sakta - sirf Centre-State ya State-State disputes ke liye hai.

detail: SC apne vivek se kisi bhi court ya tribunal (military tribunal ko chhodkar) ke kisi bhi faisle ke khilaf appeal ki special ijazat de sakta hai. Ye SC ki sabse chaudi discretionary power hai - aaj SC ka zyadatar workload isi se aata hai.
extra: Trap: Article 136 court-martial ke matters par apply nahi hota - ye clear exception hai jo often prelims me pucha jata hai.

answer: Power of review of the Supreme Court
detail: SC apne hi faisle ki samiksha kar sakta hai. Isi ke tahat review petition aur uske baad 'curative petition' (Rupa Ashok Hurra case 2002) ka rasta khula - ye nyay ki aakhri seedhi hai.
extra: Trap: Curative petition Article 137 ka text nahi hai, ye judicially evolved concept hai (Rupa Ashok Hurra case, 2002) - review ke baad bhi ek aur chance.

answer: Law declared by Supreme Court binding on all courts
detail: SC ka faisla poore India ke saare courts par bindingi hai - doctrine of precedent (stare decisis). Isi wajah se Kesavananda, Maneka aur Puttaswamy jaise judgments ka asar poore system par hota hai.
extra: Trap: SC khud apne precedent se strictly bound nahi hai (equal ya larger bench overrule kar sakti hai), but lower courts fully bound hain - ye asymmetry exam me pucha jata hai.

answer: Advisory jurisdiction of the Supreme Court
detail: President public importance ke kisi kanooni ya tathyatmak sawaal par SC ki raay maang sakta hai. Ye raay binding nahi hai aur SC mana bhi kar sakta hai (jaise Ayodhya Reference 1993 me). Berubari (1960), Kerala Education Bill, 2G Presidential Reference (2012) aur 2025 ka Governor-assent reference isi ke udaharan hain.
extra: Trap: Advisory opinion under Article 143 SC par binding nahi hai ki wo opinion de hi (Clause 1 me discretionary 'may'), aur opinion diya bhi jaye to Govt par binding nahi.

answer: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
detail: Ambedkar ne CAG ko 'Constitution ka sabse mahatvapurna adhikari' kaha. President dwara niyukt, 6 saal ya 65 saal ki umar tak, hataane ki prakriya SC judge jaisi. Salary Consolidated Fund par charged. Retirement ke baad Union/State ke kisi pad par kaam nahi kar sakta - isse independence bani rehti hai. Report Public Accounts Committee ke paas jaati hai.
extra: Trap: CAG salary/removal SC judge jaisa hai (security of tenure) but appointment President discretion se hota hai bina judicial-type consultation ke - CAG ek executive appointment hai.

detail: Har state ka ek Governor hoga; 7th Amendment 1956 ke baad ek hi vyakti do ya zyada states ka Governor ho sakta hai. Wo state ka constitutional head aur Centre ka pratinidhi dono hai - yahi 'dual role' aaj ke Centre-State tanav ki jad hai.
extra: Trap: 'One state - one Governor' rule 7th Amendment (1956) ke proviso se modify ho gaya, ab ek Governor multiple states ko cover kar sakta hai.

detail: Governor ko President apne haath se sign karke niyukt karta hai (yani practically Union Cabinet). Wo chunav se nahi aata - isliye Sarkaria, Punchhi Commission aur S.R. Bommai me kaha gaya ki niyukti me State ke CM se salah honi chahiye.
extra: Trap: Governor election nahi hota, purely Presidential (i.e., Union executive) appointment hai - koi eligibility consultation with state constitutionally mandatory nahi.

detail: Term 5 saal, par 'President ke prasad-paryant' (during the pleasure of the President) - yani kabhi bhi hataya ja sakta hai. B.P. Singhal case (2010) me SC ne kaha sarkar badalne par thok-bajaakar Governor hataana galat hai, kaaran vaajib hona chahiye.
extra: Trap: 'Doctrine of pleasure' absolute nahi hai post-B.P. Singhal (2010) - removal arbitrary/malafide nahi honi chahiye though reasons disclose karna mandatory nahi.

detail: State law ke tahat di gayi saza me pardon, commutation, remission, respite aur reprieve. Antar: Governor court-martial ki saza maaf nahi kar sakta aur death sentence ko pardon nahi kar sakta (sirf suspend/remit/commute kar sakta hai) - wo sirf President ke paas hai.
extra: placeholder

answer: Extent of executive power of the State
detail: State ki executive power wahan tak jahan tak uski Legislature kanoon bana sakti hai. Concurrent List ke maamlon me agar Centre ne khud executive power le li ho to State ki power us hadd tak seemit ho jaati hai.
extra: Trap: State executive power Concurrent List ke matters tak bhi extend ho sakti hai jab tak Union ne occupy field na kiya ho - complete exclusion nahi hai.

answer: Council of Ministers to aid and advise the Governor
detail: CM ke netritva me Council of Ministers Governor ko salah deti hai - siwaay un maamlon ke jahan Governor ko 'discretion' hai (jaise President ke liye bill reserve karna, Art 356 ki report, hung assembly me CM chunna). Ye discretion Union President ke muqable Governor ko zyada taakat deta hai.
extra: Trap: Governor discretion ka scope Article 163 me explicitly define nahi hai - courts ne case-by-case interpret kiya hai (jaise Nabam Rebia case), ye 'situational' hai.

answer: Appointment of Chief Minister and Ministers
detail: 164(1): Governor CM ko niyukt karta hai aur baaki mantriyon ko CM ki salah par; Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, MP aur Odisha me ek Tribal Welfare Minister zaroori (94th Amendment). 164(1A) (91st Amendment): mantriyon ki sankhya Vidhan Sabha ke 15% se zyada aur 12 se kam nahi. 164(2): Council of Ministers Vidhan Sabha ke prati samuhik roop se uttardayi.
extra: Trap: Minister-council max 15% of Assembly strength hai, minimum 12 - ye 91st Amendment (2003) se aaya, original Constitution me ye cap nahi thi.

detail: State ka sabse bada law officer, Governor dwara niyukt, yogyata High Court judge jaisi. State ko legal salah deta hai aur state ke saare courts me pesh ho sakta hai; Vidhan Mandal ki karyavahi me bol sakta hai par vote nahi.
extra: Trap: Advocate General Governor ki 'pleasure' par hold karta hai (fixed tenure nahi), Attorney General (Union, Article 76) ka bhi same structure hai.

answer: Abolition or creation of Legislative Councils
detail: Parliament kisi state me Vidhan Parishad bana ya khatam kar sakti hai, par tabhi jab us state ki Vidhan Sabha special majority se resolution paas kare. Aisa kanoon Art 368 ka amendment nahi maana jata - simple majority se pass hota hai. Abhi 6 states me Council hai (UP, Bihar, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh).
extra: Trap: State Assembly resolution sirf 'recommendation' hai, binding nahi hai Parliament par - Parliament chahe to ignore kar sakti hai ya delay kar sakti hai (jaise Rajasthan/Assam cases).

detail: Do sessions ke beech 6 mahine se zyada gap nahi. Governor session bula sakta hai, prorogue kar sakta hai aur Vidhan Sabha bhang kar sakta hai - ye faisle aam taur par CM ki salah par hote hain (Nabam Rebia case 2016 ne Arunachal me Governor ke ekpakshiya faisle ko rad kiya).
extra: Trap: Legislative Council (jaha exist karti hai) kabhi dissolve nahi hoti, sirf Assembly dissolve hoti hai - RS jaisa hi parallel state level par.

answer: Assent to Bills by the Governor
detail: Governor ke paas 4 vikalp: assent de, assent rok le, bill (Money Bill chhodkar) punarvichar ke liye wapas bhej de, ya President ke liye reserve kar de. Agar House dobara paas kar de to Governor ko assent dena hi hoga. 'Kitna samay le sakta hai' - ye Punjab, Tamil Nadu aur Kerala ke recent cases ka mool sawaal raha hai; SC ne kaha Governor bill par anant samay tak baith nahi sakta.
extra: Trap: Governor bill dusri baar reconsideration ke baad withhold nahi kar sakta, assent dena mandatory hai - sirf pehli baar hi withhold/return option available hai.

answer: Bills reserved for the consideration of the President
detail: President reserved bill par assent de sakta hai, rok sakta hai, ya (Money Bill ke alawa) punarvichar ke liye wapas bhej sakta hai. Yahan President par koi time limit constitution me likhi nahi hai - isliye ise 'pocket veto' ka rasta maana jata hai, jis par ab judicial guidance aa rahi hai.
extra: Trap: Unlike Article 200 ka state bill (jaha dobara pass hone par Governor assent dena mandatory), Article 201 me President dobara pass bill ko bhi assent dena mandatory nahi hai.

detail: Jab Vidhan Mandal ka session na chal raha ho, Governor ordinance la sakta hai; House ke baithne ke 6 hafte me manzoori chahiye. Kuch maamlon me (jaise wo bill jinke liye President ki poorva-manzoori chahiye) Governor ko pehle President ke nirdesh lene padte hain.
extra: Trap: State ordinance jinme High Court se related matters ho, unke liye Governor ko President se prior instructions leni padti hai - ye extra safeguard Union ordinance (Article 123) me nahi hai.

detail: Har rajya ka ek High Court hoga. Art 231 do ya zyada states/UTs ke liye common High Court ki ijazat deta hai - jaise Punjab & Haryana HC, Guwahati HC (kai North-East states).
extra: Trap: 'One state - one High Court' bhi 7th Amendment (1956) ke proviso se modified hai, jaise state level Governor wale rule - dono articles (153, 214) me parallel structure hai.

answer: High Courts to be courts of record
detail: High Court ke faisle record hote hain aur wo apni avmanna par saza de sakta hai - Art 129 ka state-level mirror.
extra: Trap: HC ki contempt power bhi constitutional hai (Article 215) jaisi SC ki (Article 129), statutory limitation se curtail nahi ki ja sakti.

detail: Har HC me ek Chief Justice aur President dwara samay-samay par tay kiye gaye judges honge - SC ke ulta yahan judges ki sankhya fixed nahi hai, workload ke hisaab se badalti hai.
extra: placeholder

answer: Appointment and conditions of office of a High Court Judge
detail: President CJI, us state ke Governor aur HC ke Chief Justice se salah karke niyukt karta hai (aaj collegium ke through). Yogyata: Indian citizen + 10 saal judicial office ya 10 saal HC advocate. Retirement 62 saal (SC me 65).
extra: Trap: HC judge retirement age 62 hai, SC judge ki 65 - common confusion point in prelims.

answer: Oath by Judges of High Courts
detail: HC judge Governor (ya unke dwara niyukt vyakti) ke saamne shapath leta hai - Constitution aur law ka palan aur bina bhay/pakshpaat ke nyay dene ka vachan.
extra: Trap: HC judges Governor ke samne oath lete hain (ya President-appointed person), SC judges President ke samne - dono ka format Third Schedule me common hai.

answer: Power of High Courts to issue writs
detail: HC 5 writs jaari kar sakta hai - Fundamental Rights ke liye bhi aur 'kisi bhi anya uddeshya' yani samanya legal rights ke liye bhi. Isliye Art 226 ka daayra Art 32 se chauda hai. Chandra Kumar case (1997): Art 226 ka judicial review basic structure hai, tribunal ise khatam nahi kar sakta.
extra: Trap: Article 226 ka scope Article 32 se wider hai (FR + other legal rights dono cover), lekin Article 32 khud ek Fundamental Right hai (SC direct approach ka), Article 226 discretionary remedy hai.

detail: District Judge ki niyukti Governor High Court se salah karke karta hai. Yogyata: pehle se Union/State ki service me na ho aur 7 saal se advocate ho, aur HC ki sifarish ho - isse subordinate judiciary par HC ka niyantran bana rehta hai.
extra: Trap: District Judge appointment me Governor ki role hai but effectively HC ki recommendation binding jaisi hoti hai practice me - judicial independence maintain karne ke liye.

detail: UT ka prashasan President chalata hai, chahe khud ya Administrator/Lieutenant Governor ke through. Kuch UTs (Puducherry, Delhi, J&K) me Legislature bhi hai.
extra: Trap: Sabhi UTs me elected assembly nahi hoti - sirf Delhi, Puducherry, J&K (special status) me hoti hai, baaki fully Centrally administered.

answer: Special provisions with respect to Delhi
detail: 69th Amendment 1991 - Delhi 'National Capital Territory' bana, 70-seat Vidhan Sabha aur Council of Ministers mila. Par Public Order, Police aur Land Centre ke paas rahe. NCT of Delhi v. Union of India (2018, 2023) me SC ne kaha LG ko elected sarkar ki salah par chalna hoga - phir 2023 ke GNCTD Amendment Act ne services par Centre ka niyantran bahal kiya.
extra: Trap: Delhi me police, public order, aur land par Delhi Assembly legislate nahi kar sakti - ye Union subjects hain, bawajood Delhi ke apni legislature hone ke.

detail: Parliament kisi UT ke liye HC bana sakti hai ya kisi court ko UT ka HC ghoshit kar sakti hai - Delhi ka apna HC isi ka udaharan hai.
extra: Trap: Sirf Delhi ka apna dedicated High Court hai UTs me se; baaki UTs states ke High Courts ki extended jurisdiction share karte hain.

detail: Gaon ke voter list me darj sab logon ki sabha - ye Panchayati Raj ki neenv aur direct democracy ka roop hai. Uske adhikar State Legislature tay karti hai; PESA 1996 ne Scheduled Areas me Gram Sabha ko kaafi taakat di (land acquisition/resource par consent).
extra: Trap: Gram Sabha ke powers Constitution khud define nahi karta - purely State Legislature ki law par depend karta hai, isliye state-to-state variation hoti hai.

detail: Har state me 3-tier Panchayat - Village, Intermediate aur District level. 20 lakh se kam aabadi wale states intermediate level chhod sakte hain.
extra: Trap: 20 lakh se kam population wale states intermediate tier skip kar sakte hain - proviso to Article 243B(1), often exam me confuse hota hai 'compulsory 3-tier' samajhkar.

detail: Panchayat ke saare seats sidhe chunav se bharenge (direct election). Chairperson ka chunav village level par state ke kanoon ke anusar, aur intermediate/district level par elected members ke beech se hota hai.
extra: Trap: Panchayat composition ke exact election mode (direct/indirect chairperson) Constitution rigid nahi karta - state law flexibility rakhti hai within broad framework.

detail: SC/ST ke liye aabadi ke anupat me reservation aur har category me 1/3rd seats mahilaon ke liye (kai states ne ise 50% kar diya hai). Chairperson ke pad par bhi reservation lagta hai; OBC reservation State Legislature ke vivek par hai (par SC ne Triple Test lazmi kiya).
extra: Trap: Constitutional minimum women reservation 1/3rd hai, 50% wala kai states ka apna additional state-law provision hai, Union-wide constitutional mandate nahi (abhi tak koi amendment 50% ko constitutionally mandate nahi karta).

detail: Governor har 5 saal me State Finance Commission banayega jo State-Panchayat ke beech tax/revenue ke baantwaare aur grants-in-aid par sifarish karega. Central Finance Commission (Art 280) inki sifarishon ko dhyan me rakhta hai.
extra: Trap: SFC recommendations Governor/State govt par binding nahi hain (advisory only) - Union Finance Commission jaisi statutory obligation nahi hai inhe accept karne ki, though action-taken report legislature me zaroor place karni hoti hai.

detail: State Election Commission (Governor dwara niyukt SEC) panchayat chunav ki superintendence, direction aur control karti hai - ye ECI se alag sanstha hai. Iski independence HC judge ki tarah surakshit hai.
extra: Trap: SEC aur ECI alag sansthayein hain - SEC sirf panchayat/municipality chunav dekhta hai, Parliament/Vidhan Sabha nahi. SEC Governor niyukt karta hai, President nahi.

detail: Teen tarah ki municipality: Nagar Panchayat (gaon se shehar ban raha kshetra), Municipal Council (chhota shehar) aur Municipal Corporation (bada shehar). Vargikaran aabadi, revenue density aur non-agricultural rozgar ke aadhar par hota hai.
extra: Trap: teenon municipality types ka criteria sirf population nahi - density, non-agri employment aur economic importance bhi factors hain, aur industrial township exception discretionary hai.

detail: Shehri nikayon ke chunav bhi State Election Commission karati hai - yani Art 243K wali sanstha hi shehri chunav bhi dekhti hai.
extra: Trap: ek hi SEC panchayat aur municipality dono ke chunav karata hai - alag-alag body nahi hoti, students isse confuse karte hain.

detail: Har zile me District Planning Committee jo Panchayat aur Municipality ke draft plans ko milakar zila-star ka vikas plan banati hai; 4/5th members chunkar aate hain.
extra: Trap: DPC me 4/5th members chune hue hi hone chahiye - poore members elected nahi hote, kuch state legislature ke discretion se aa sakte hain.

detail: State kanoon banakar co-operative societies ke gathan, panjikaran aur band hone ki vyavastha karega - swaichhik gathan, loktantrik niyantran aur sadasyon ki aarthik bhagidari ke siddhanton par. (2021 me SC ne Part IX-B ke state-level provisions ko ratification ki kami ke chalte rad kiya.)
extra: Trap: 97th Amendment ka poora Part IX-B invalid nahi hua - sirf 'states' par lagu hone wala hissa ratification na hone ki wajah se rad hua, Union Territories/Multi-State societies wala portion valid raha.

answer: Extent of laws made by Parliament and by State Legislatures
detail: Parliament poore ya kisi bhi hisse ke liye kanoon bana sakti hai, State Legislature sirf apne rajya ke liye. Parliament ke kanoon ko 'extra-territorial operation' ke aadhar par challenge nahi kiya ja sakta.
extra: Trap: ye article 'kya' banaya ja sakta hai (subject) nahi balki 'kahan tak' (territorial extent) tay karta hai - subject-matter division Art 246 me hai, isse mix mat karo.

detail: Union List (100), State List (61) aur Concurrent List (52) ka baantwara. Union List par Parliament ka special adhikar, Concurrent par dono, aur State List par sadharantah rajya. Overlap hone par 'doctrine of pith and substance' aur 'colourable legislation' ke tests lagte hain.
extra: Trap: 7th Schedule ke teeno list ka number - Union 100, State 61, Concurrent 52 (originally 97, 66, 47 the, baad me change hue) - exact current numbers yaad rakhna zaroori hai.

answer: Parliament's power to legislate on State List in the national interest
detail: Agar Rajya Sabha upasthit-aur-vote karne walon ke 2/3rd bahumat se resolution paas kare ki koi State List ka vishay 'rashtriya hit' me hai, to Parliament us par 1 saal tak kanoon bana sakti hai (aur badhaya ja sakta hai). Ye Rajya Sabha ki federal chamber wali khaas power hai.
extra: Trap: ye normal, non-emergency provision hai (Lok Sabha involved nahi hoti), jabki Art 250 sirf National Emergency ke dauran lagta hai - dono ko confuse na karo.

answer: Parliament's power during a Proclamation of Emergency
detail: National Emergency ke dauran Parliament State List ke kisi bhi vishay par kanoon bana sakti hai; aisa kanoon emergency khatam hone ke 6 mahine baad tak chalta hai.
extra: Trap: Art 250 ka kanoon Emergency khatam hone ke 6 mahine baad automatically inoperative ho jata hai bina kisi alag repeal ke - students isse 'permanent' samajh lete hain.

answer: Legislation for two or more States by consent
detail: Do ya zyada states apni Vidhan Sabha se resolution paas karke Parliament se apne liye State List par kanoon banwa sakti hain - jaise Wildlife Protection Act 1972 aur Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act 1974.
extra: Trap: is tarah bana kanoon sirf Parliament amend kar sakti hai, sambandhit state legislature use khud nahi badal sakti - autonomy sonp di jaati hai.

answer: Legislation for giving effect to international agreements
detail: Kisi bhi antarrashtriya sandhi, samjhaute ya sammelan ko lagu karne ke liye Parliament State List par bhi kanoon bana sakti hai - states ki sehmati ki zaroorat nahi. Environment Protection Act 1986 (Stockholm Conference ke baad) isi ka nateeja hai.
extra: Trap: Art 253 me states ki sehmati bilkul zaroori nahi hai - ye Art 252 (states ki sehmati chahiye) se bilkul ulta hai, dono ko exam me swap karke poocha jata hai.

answer: Inconsistency between Central and State laws
detail: Concurrent List par takraav me Central law prevail karega aur State law us hadd tak void. Apwaad: agar State law President ke assent se paas ho to us state me wo chalega - par Parliament baad me use overrule kar sakti hai. Farm laws aur labour codes wali bahas isi article par tiki thi.
extra: Trap: President ka assent milne par bhi state law permanent surakshit nahi rehta - Parliament baad me usi vishay par kanoon banakar use overrule kar sakti hai, ye double-edged proviso hai.

detail: Parliament kanoon bana kar nadi-jal vivaad ka nipatara tribunal ko de sakti hai aur SC/kisi bhi court ka adhikar-kshetra rok sakti hai. Isi ke tahat Inter-State River Water Disputes Act 1956 bana - Cauvery, Krishna, Ravi-Beas tribunals iske udaharan hain.
extra: Trap: Art 262(2) SC ke jurisdiction ko sirf river water disputes ke liye ouster karti hai, aur wo bhi statute se - Constitution khud automatically ouster nahi karta, Parliament ko kanoon banana padta hai.

detail: President Inter-State Council bana sakta hai jo states ke beech vivaad ki jaanch kare aur samanya hit ke vishayon par salah de. Sarkaria Commission ki sifarish par 1990 me iska gathan hua - ye cooperative federalism ka manch hai.
extra: Trap: Inter-State Council ka gathan President ke discretion (mandatory nahi) par nirbhar hai aur ye statutory body hai jo 1990 me bani - Art 263 khud koi body create nahi karta, sirf power deta hai.

detail: Consolidated Fund of India me sarkar ki saari aay aur udhaar jaate hain, aur wahan se paisa Parliament ki manzoori (Appropriation Act) ke bina nahi nikalta. Public Account me wo paisa jahan sarkar sirf banker hai (PF, small savings) - iske liye Parliament ki vote zaroori nahi.
extra: Trap: Public Account se nikalne ke liye Parliament ki appropriation/vote zaroori nahi hai - ye common confusion point hai students Consolidated Fund jaisa hi samajh lete hain.

detail: Achanak/unforeseen kharche ke liye imprest fund, jo President ke paas rehta hai (abhi corpus Rs 30,000 crore). Baad me Parliament se manzoori lekar ye paisa Consolidated Fund se wapas bhara jata hai.
extra: Trap: Contingency Fund President ke 'disposal' par hota hai lekin technically ye Parliament ke kanoon se banta hai, aur ismese liya paisa baad me zaroori roop se Consolidated Fund se replenish kiya jata hai.

detail: President har 5 saal (ya pehle) me Finance Commission banata hai - ek chairman aur 4 sadasya. Kaam: Centre aur States ke beech taxes ka baantwara (vertical devolution), states ke beech share (horizontal), local bodies ke liye grants aur grants-in-aid. 15th FC ne 41% devolution ki sifarish ki. Iski sifarish binding nahi par parampara se maani jaati hai.
extra: Trap: FC ki sifarishen legally binding nahi hain (advisory), jabki Election Commission ke nirdesh binding hote hain - ye difference exam me poocha jata hai.

detail: 44th Amendment 1978 ne property ko Fundamental Right (Art 19(1)(f) aur 31) se hataakar yahan constitutional/legal right bana diya. Ab bina kanoon ke authority ke kisi ki sampatti nahi cheeni ja sakti, par uske liye Art 32 ke bajay Art 226 ya samanya court jaana padta hai.
extra: Trap: Right to Property ab constitutional/legal right hai, Fundamental Right nahi hai - isliye iska ullanghan hone par Art 32 (writ to SC as FR remedy) directly nahi lagta, sirf Art 226 ya suit se.

answer: Freedom of trade, commerce and intercourse
detail: Poore India me vyapar aur aavagaman ki azadi - 'India ek economic union hai'. Art 302-305 me reasonable restrictions ka provision hai; Art 304(a) kehta hai state bahar ke maal par apne maal se zyada tax nahi laga sakta. GST ka poora tarq isi economic unity par khada hai.
extra: Trap: Art 301 ka 'freedom' absolute nahi hai - reasonable, non-discriminatory regulatory/compensatory taxes allowed hain, ye trade ki freedom ko violate nahi karte (Jindal Stainless 2016 landmark).

detail: Rajya Sabha agar upasthit-aur-vote karne walon ke 2/3rd bahumat se resolution paas kare ki rashtriya hit me nayi All India Service zaroori hai, to Parliament use bana sakti hai. Abhi teen hain - IAS, IPS aur IFoS (Indian Forest Service). All India Judicial Service ka prastav isi article ke tahat hai.
extra: Trap: naye All India Service banane ke liye sirf Rajya Sabha ka special resolution chahiye, Lok Sabha ki involvement nahi - ye Art 249 jaisa hi Rajya Sabha ka unique federal power hai.

answer: Public Service Commissions for the Union and the States
detail: UPSC aur har state ka SPSC. Do ya zyada states mil kar Joint State PSC (Parliament ke kanoon se) bana sakte hain. Art 316 niyukti aur karyakaal (6 saal ya 65/62 saal), Art 317 hataane ki prakriya (SC ki jaanch ke baad President), Art 320 kaam, Art 323 saalana report.
extra: Trap: UPSC member ki removal ke liye bhi President order karta hai (chahe wo UPSC ho ya SPSC), sirf SC ki inquiry ka reference alag hota hai - Parliament impeachment jaisi prakriya nahi hoti.

detail: ECI ke paas Parliament, State Legislature, President aur Vice-President ke chunav ka superintendence, direction aur control hai. 1989 se multi-member (CEC + 2 ECs).
